options.name: Platforms
options.description: The messaging platforms available to the team, with what each one supports.

options.name: Team
options.description: The team the API token belongs to, and its members: the Inboxapp users who work in it.

options.name: Account Links
options.description: Platform accounts the team connected to Inboxapp. Every thread belongs to one, and messages are sent from one.

options.name: Contacts
options.description: The team's record of a person, holding its CRM state: status, tags, notes, valuation and default assignee. A contact groups one or more profiles, a person's accounts on the platforms.

options.name: Threads
options.description: Conversations between one of the team's account links and one profile.

options.name: Messages
options.description: Messages in a thread, and sending, editing, unsending and reacting to them on the platform.

options.name: Tags
options.description: Labels the team puts on contacts.

options.name: Statuses
options.description: The pipeline stages a contact can be in, such as a deal stage. A contact has at most one.

options.name: Colors
options.description: The colors of Inboxapp's palette, for tags and statuses.

options.name: Events
options.description: Changes in the team, as delivered to v2 webhooks. Each event names the object that changed and carries only the values of the change; read the object for its current state. Events are kept for 7 days, up to 25,000 per team.

options.name: Platforms List
options.description: Each platform's capabilities and limits. An account link's `capabilities` can only narrow its platform's.

options.name: Team Get
options.description: Get team

options.name: Team List Members
options.description: List members

options.name: Team Get Member
options.description: Get member

options.name: Account Links List
options.description: List account links

options.name: Account Links Get
options.description: Get account link

options.name: Contacts List
options.description: Finds contacts by the platform identity of one of their profiles: a `platform` with `platformId` or `username`.

options.name: Contacts Get
options.description: Get contact

options.name: Contacts Update
options.description: Update contact

options.name: Contacts Add Tag
options.description: Adding a tag the contact already has succeeds.

options.name: Contacts Remove Tag
options.description: Removing a tag the contact doesn't have succeeds.

options.name: Threads List
options.description: Threads in inbox order, filtered by folder and by contact CRM state.

options.name: Threads Get
options.description: Get thread

options.name: Threads Update
options.description: Update thread

options.name: Threads Delete
options.description: Deletes the conversation on the platform when it can, and always in Inboxapp. The response's `scope` says which happened.

options.name: Threads Typing
options.description: Shows the account link as typing in the conversation. At most one per thread every 2.5 seconds; extra calls return `skipped`.

options.name: Messages List
options.description: List messages

options.name: Messages Get
options.description: Get message

options.name: Messages Edit
options.description: Edits the message on the platform. Needs `message:edit`, within the platform's edit window.

options.name: Messages Unsend
options.description: Delete message

options.name: Messages Send
options.description: `201` for a new send. A replay of an `Idempotency-Key` returns the original result with `200`.

options.name: Messages History
options.description: Every version of the message's content, from its edits.

options.name: Messages React
options.description: Add reaction

options.name: Messages Unreact
options.description: Remove reaction

options.name: Messages Attachment
options.description: `200` with a fresh URL once ready, `202` while the media is pending or processing. A card index is `invalidRequest`.

options.description: Update tag

options.name: contactId
options.description: Threads with these contacts. With `accountLinkId`, finds the thread between an account and a contact. Add several to match any of them.

options.name: folder
options.description: Defaults to `inbox`, threads that are neither archived nor requests. `noReply` is the `inbox` threads whose latest activity is inbound. `requests` holds unarchived threads where `isRequest` is true. `archived` includes requests. `all` spans every folder. Every other filter narrows the folder.

options.name: tag
options.description: Threads whose contact has one of these tags. Add several to match any of them.

options.name: status
options.description: Threads whose contact has one of these statuses. Add several to match any of them.

options.name: assigneeId
options.description: Threads whose `assigneeId`, the thread's own assignee or else its contact's, is one of these members. Add several to match any of them.

options.name: unassigned
options.description: `true` keeps threads with no assignee, including through their contact. Not combinable with `assigneeId`.

options.name: campaignId
options.description: Threads these campaigns sent a message in. Campaign sends archive the thread, so pair it with `folder=archived` or `all`. Add several to match any of them.

options.name: q
options.description: Searches profile display names, usernames and the activity preview. Results follow `order`, not relevance.

options.name: order
options.description: Sort direction by inbox order: `activity.at`, or `createdAt` for a thread with no activity. A reminder or an accepted message request moves a thread up until its next message, without changing `activity.at`. Defaults to `desc`, newest first.
